# tenarium_entitlements (Data Source)

A tenant's effective entitlements: the plan's features and limits with the tenant's overrides applied.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenarium_entitlements" "acme" {
  tenant_id = "acme"
}

output "acme_has_sso" {
  value = lookup(data.tenarium_entitlements.acme.features, "sso", false)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID or slug.

### Read-Only

- `features` (Map of Boolean) Effective feature flags.
- `limits` (Map of Number) Effective limits; absent metrics are unlimited.
- `plan` (String) Plan ID.
